title: Antibiotics
intro: Antibiotics are an artificial medical item used to treat Afflictions in The Long Dark.

title: Antiseptic

fields.name: Antiseptic
fields.examine: A bottle of Hydrogen Peroxide. Useful for cleaning wounds.

intro: Antiseptic is a First Aid item used to remove Infection Risk gained from hostile Wildlife attacks.

title: Bandage

fields.name: Bandage
fields.examine: Bandage suitable for stopping blood loss or binding to constrict movement on an injury.

intro: A Bandage is a First Aid cloth used for stopping bleeding or limb immobilization in The Long Dark.

title: Blackrock Infirmary Medication

fields.name: Blackrock Infirmary Medication
fields.actions_ground: Take It, Read Text, Leave It
fields.examine: Vials of morphine and injectable antibiotics.

intro: Blackrock Infirmary Medication is a First Aid item found in Episode 4 of the Wintermute story mode during the mission Blackrock Blues.

title: Canister
intro: Canisters work in tandem with a Respirator, are used to prevent Suffocation from toxic gases found inside mineshafts, as well as preventing Chemical Poisoning from occurring when walking around chemical spills on the surface of the Zone of Contamination.

title: Emergency Stim

fields.name: Emergency Stim
fields.examine: Emergency steroid injection. Will provide a short-burst of energy. Then you'll collapse from exhaustion. Use as last resort!

intro: Emergency Stim is a First Aid item in The Long Dark. Upon use, it will restore some of the survivor's Condition and grant them unlimited energy for sprinting and rope climbing for one minute.

title: Heat Pack

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things|Episode 5]
fields.examine: A single-use, disposable Heat Pack. Provides a small amount of warmth when activated.

intro: It is only acquired when trading with the Trader at higher levels of Trust, or in Chapter Five of Wintermute. It provides the positive Heat Pack (Affliction) when used.

title: Insulin

fields.name: Insulin
fields.examine: Helps to regulate levels of blood glucose.

intro: Insulin is a First Aid item found in Episode 3 of the Wintermute story mode as a part of the Fallen Star mission.

title: Military Stim

fields.story: [Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things]
fields.examine: Experimental Military Stim - Test # 2.003 Caution: Use only in extreme circumstances to restore Condition.

intro: Caution: Use only in extreme circumstances to restore Condition.|stackable=No|actions=}}A Military Stim is a First Aid item found exclusively in Episode 5: The Light At The End Of All Things in the Wintermute story of The Long Dark.

title: Painkillers
intro: Painkillers are an artificial medical item used to treat Afflictions in The Long Dark.

title: Respirator

fields.name: Respirator
fields.examine: Equip to protect yourself from toxic gas and other environmental hazards. Requires Canisters to function.

intro: It is one of the few items that cannot be dropped or placed in containers so it cannot be lost, similar to the Handheld Shortwave Radio and Camera.

title: Water Purification Tablets
intro: Water Purification Tablets are a consumable to convert Unsafe Water into Potable Water in The Long Dark.
